Section 1. [+INTERCHANGE AT INTERSTATE HIGHWAY 35 AND COUNTY STATE-AID HIGHWAY 19; CHISAGO COUNTY. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; appropriating money for an interchange at Interstate Highway 35 and County State-Aid Highway 19 in Chisago County; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. INTERCHANGE AT INTERSTATE HIGHWAY 35 AND COUNTY STATE-AID HIGHWAY 19; CHISAGO COUNTY.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

$1,500,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of transportation for a grant to Chisago County for preliminary engineering, environmental review, final design engineering, and right-of-way acquisition for the reconstruction of the interchange at the intersection of marked Interstate Highway 35 and County State-Aid Highway 19 in Chisago County and reconstruction of County State-Aid Highway 19 and associated city streets from the intersection of County State-Aid Highway 19 and marked Interstate Highway 35 up to and including the intersection of County State-Aid Highway 30.

Subd. 2.

Bond sale.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $1,500,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: INTERCHANGE AT INTERSTATE HIGHWAY 35 AND COUNTY STATE-AID HIGHWAY 19; CHISAGO COUNTY.

$1,500,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of transportation for a grant to Chisago County for preliminary engineering, environmental review, final design engineering, and right-of-way acquisition for the reconstruction of the interchange at the intersection of marked Interstate Highway 35 and County State-Aid Highway 19 in Chisago County and reconstruction of County State-Aid Highway 19 and associated city streets from the intersection of County State-Aid Highway 19 and marked Interstate Highway 35 up to and including the intersection of County State-Aid Highway 30.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $1,500,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
